title: The opposition
line: Kings face each other: whoever has to move must give way.

steps.text: The kings face each other with one square between them. Neither may step onto e5. This standoff is the opposition.
Kings never stand side by side, so whoever has to move here must step aside. The side that does not have to move has the opposition.
Black had to move and stepped aside. Walk your king forward past it.

also.e4d4: That keeps the opposition too, and Black must give way again. This lesson goes the other way, past the king.
also.e4f4: That works too: Black cannot hold the squares in front of the pawn. This lesson goes forward at once.

wrong.e4d3: That steps back, and Black's king comes forward. The game is drawn.
wrong.e4f3: That steps back, and Black's king comes forward. The game is drawn.

steps.hint: Go forward on the side the black king left.
steps.after: Your king is ahead of the pawn, and Black can no longer stop it.

steps.text: Now you have Black. Take the opposition: face the white king with one square between.

wrong.e7d6: That lets the white king step forward, and the pawn promotes.
wrong.e7f6: That lets the white king step forward, and the pawn promotes.
wrong.e7d7: That lets the white king step forward, and the pawn promotes.
wrong.e7f7: That lets the white king step forward, and the pawn promotes.
wrong.e7d8: That lets the white king step forward, and the pawn promotes.
wrong.e7e8: That lets the white king step forward, and the pawn promotes.
wrong.e7f8: That lets the white king step forward, and the pawn promotes.

steps.hint: Stand straight in front of the white king.
steps.after: White has to move now and give way. The game is drawn.

steps.text: You have White again. Take the opposition yourself, so that Black has to move.

wrong.d3d4: The pawn moved first, and Black keeps your king out. The game is drawn.
wrong.c4b5: That lets the black king attack your pawn, and the game is drawn.
wrong.c4c3: That steps back, and Black keeps the squares in front of the pawn. The game is drawn.

steps.hint: Stand on the same file as the black king, one square between.

steps.text: Black stepped to one side. Go past on the other.

also.d4e4: That takes the opposition again, and Black must give way once more. This lesson goes past the king.
also.d4c4: That works too. This lesson goes forward at once.

steps.hint: Step forward on the side away from the black king.
steps.after: Your king is ahead of the pawn now, and the pawn will promote.

summary: When the kings face each other with one square between, whoever has to move must give way.
